content.title: Brazil vs France prediction: team news, lineups, expert analysis
content.text: Both teams are likely to score Published: 24 Mar 2026, 13:50 On March 26, 2026, a friendly match will take place between the national teams of Brazil and France. The favorites for the upcoming World Cup will test who is stronger at the moment.Brazil vs France: Team News and Expert AnalysisBrazil had considerable difficulties during qualification. They changed coaches multiple times until Ancelotti took over last summer. Still, they managed no more than two wins in a row. The qualifiers ended with 28 points from eighteen matches, finishing fifth; even in friendlies afterward, things didn’t always go well: they lost to Japan and drew with Senegal.France, since their “home” Euros, has been coached by Deschamps. However, he will definitely depart after the upcoming World Cup. Qualifying was relatively smooth, although they barely beat Iceland at home and were held to a 2-2 draw away.The South Americans average 1.7 goals scored and concede one per match. The European powerhouse boasts better stats: 2.4 goals scored and 1.1 conceded per game.Previous Matches: Brazil vs FranceFrance has won four times, including twice at World Cups, with two draws. However, in the last friendlies in 2013 and 2015, they lost, conceding three goals each time.This main match of the day is unlikely to be boring. The prediction is "both teams to score" (odds – 1.60).Brazil vs France: Key Stats and TrendsBrazil has won two of their last five matches40% of Brazil's matches end with both teams scoring, with an average total of 2.7 goals per matchFrance has won six of their last seven games40% of France's matches end with both teams scoring, with an average total of 3.5 goals per matchBrazil vs France: Possible Starting Line-upsBrazil is expected to play in a 1-4-4-2 formation (possible line-up): Ederson - David Luiz, Marquinhos, Wesley - Fabinho, Casemiro, Andrey Santos, Raphinha - Vinicius Junior, Matheus Cunha. Not available for various reasons: Alisson, Alex Sandro, Gabriel, Marquinhos, Militao, Bruno Guimaraes, Lucas Paqueta, Rodrygo, Estevao, and Neymar has not yet returned.France is likely to line up in a 1-4-5-1 formation (possible line-up): Maignan - Theo, Lucas Hernandez, Konate, Gusto - Camavinga, Zaïre-Emery, Ekitike, Akliouche, Olise - Mbappe.
